items.content_html: SnappyShare is a lightweight, secure, and login-free file sharing web app built using React (Vite) and Supabase. Users can instantly upload a file and receive a 4-digit OTP to share with others for secure, one-time access. All files automatically expire in 5 minutes for privacy and cleanup.
